accessibility.evidence: Labelled destination and comment inputs, aria-pressed on follow/like/tabs/privacy, status feedback for share and comments, visible keyboard focus asserted. Buttons and links have 44–48px minimum height. Reviewed navy text on ivory and legible preview badges.

responsive.evidence: Checked each of seven feature routes plus hub, Home and Profile at 360px, 390px and 1440px. No page overflow. Desktop hub uses two columns; mobile controls wrap. Rendered screenshots inspected locally.

loading.reason: New surfaces render bundled frontend content without asynchronous data requests. External maps and provider pages are separate destinations.

empty.evidence: Local hosts, hotels and hidden-location screens explain missing listings/data and offer working map or existing-app links.

error.evidence: Unknown feature route returns HTTP 404. Clipboard share failure has browser-address recovery feedback; share feedback asserted.

partial.evidence: Existing memories, passport, artisans and trails remain accessible alongside explicitly unavailable account, booking, pricing and location-import integrations.

success.evidence: Sample likes, following and comment submission update visibly. Feed tabs change sample copy. Reload resets ephemeral social interactions; privacy toggle updates explanation.

permission.evidence: Account visibility clearly states preview-only and does not change permissions or upload memories. No geolocation requested; maps use only entered area.

renderedEvidence.observation: Mobile community preview: wrapped controls, readable labels, sample disclosure and inline social actions.
Desktop feature hub: seven destinations, paired image rows, readable headings and status labels.
